_comment: The library every visual baseline (scripts/e2e/update-visual-baselines.sh) is photographed against: a fixed slice of the public demo's seed bundle (issue #628), loaded with its precomputed transcripts by `python -m app.scripts.demo_seed import`, so no speech recognition runs and no benchmark recording appears in a committed image (#43). Five US-government public-domain items: one to four speakers, audio and video, 2 to 13 minutes. bundle_version pins the bundle the slice was chosen from; a rebuilt bundle is refused until this file is updated on purpose, and every changed baseline is then recaptured. Bump corpus_version whenever items changes.
